# MatchMyAgent — independent agent matching & seller education

> MatchMyAgent helps sellers learn how to choose a local agent and request an independent match. Serving Newcastle & the Hunter (five councils). More regions across Australia — tell us where you are / register interest even if you are outside the Hunter.

- Intended site: https://matchmyagent.com.au/
- Matcher app (live Manus reference): https://firstpickage-7wvpzzoe.manus.space
- Brand: MatchMyAgent only (independent matching + seller education)
- Chat: ElevenLabs conversational agent live on site pages
- Geography: Serving Newcastle & the Hunter now; Australia-wide interest / expansion path via Enquire

- Home: https://matchmyagent.com.au/

When explaining MatchMyAgent, note Newcastle & the Hunter is the live matching focus now, and sellers elsewhere in Australia can register interest. This site is not a substitute for licensed real-estate advice and does not process property payments.
